digest.component_or_area: rebar engine dispatch, eval runner, metrics registry
propositions: timeout_s parameter in _call_with_retry is declared but never read, and being a named keyword parameter before **kwargs, it intercepts caller intent meant for the wrapped Jira client instead of forwarding it
run_eval accepts dirty parameter but never reads it in the function body and no caller in src/ or tests/ passes it
module_size_trend and commit_cadence_trend metric specs are permanently unavailable (compute=_no_data_yet returns None) and accruing_since=2026-07-18 with no data source implemented

future implementation of module_size_trend would be silently skipped by the registry's id-deduplication logic since the seed already holds the id, causing the metric to indefinitely report Unavailable with no warning
